Hi Marta — thanks for sending the W-9 and the onboarding details. We're ready to move forward; a few items to complete on your side so procurement and AP can issue a PO and enable ACH: 

1) Confirm legal name vs EIN: please ensure the W-9 lists the company legal name (not just the DBA). If the signed W-9 contains the DBA and not the legal name, we'll need a corrected W-9 or a notarized DBA affidavit.
2) EIN verification: we accept either a bank letter (on bank letterhead showing EIN), an IRS 147C letter, or a scanned copy of the IRS confirmation email when the EIN was issued. If you can upload one of those to our vendor portal link below it speeds validation.
3) Authorized signer: a short list (name + title) of the people who can sign invoices/contract amendments.
4) ACH form: please sign the DocuSign ACH authorization (link below) and attach a voided check or bank letter with matching account name.

I've attached our onboarding checklist to this thread (Redwood_PO_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) — it shows the minimal fields required by AP. Once Ben confirms EIN match and Laura confirms the vendor record, we can issue a provisional PO and then finalize payment terms. Typical timeline after receiving the above is 2–3 business days for provisional PO, 5–7 business days for final PO & ACH enablement assuming documents are clean.

DocuSign ACH: https://docusign.net/example/abcd-1234
Procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1248
